emailTitle: After strong wind, check these three things
emailDescription: A cover that's fitted right stays put in wind.
amnesrader: After strong wind, check these three things
The hooks, the straps, five minutes
Sitting right is what keeps it on

blocks.text: If it's been blowing hard where the rig is parked, it's worth a quick look before you trust it again.
Check that the hooks are still latched under the edge of the body.
Check that the straps are still snug, not loose.
Check the two extra straps too, front and back.

If something came loose or tore, reply to this email and tell me what happened.
Axel, founder
